title: Iran, Israel fire missiles at each other following US attack
description: The IDF said on X that it detected the launch of a new barrage of ballistic missiles from Iran on Monday and that Israeli warplanes began a "wave of attacks on military targets in Tehran."

title: 1 person injured after shooting at Michigan church
description: The shooter was allegedly killed by a security guard.

title: US troops in Middle East on high alert after Iran attack
description: There are around 40,000 American troops in the region, spread between permanent bases and smaller outposts, and any of them could face reprisals following the U.S. bombing operation in Iran.

title: Church staff prevents ‘large-scale mass shooting’
description: An alleged active shooter intent on attacking a Michigan church on Sunday was shot and killed by a security guard who "prevented a large-scale mass shooting," police said.

title: Concern over US troops across the Middle East
description: ABC News’ Martha Raddatz reports on growing concern of the 40,000 troops spread from Iraq, Bahrain, Qatar and Syria becoming targeted after Iran strike.

title: Trump calls US strikes in Iran a ‘tremendous success’
description: ABC News Chief Washington Correspondent Jonathan Karl spoke to President Donald Trump about what he hopes these attacks on Iran will accomplish.

title: Teen’s two-arm talent draws attention of the NFL
description: High school senior Mikey Gow could become the first ambidextrous quarterback prospect.

title: Some of Iran’s retaliation won’t unfold ‘for some time’: Former DHS official
description: The former DHS assistant secretary for counterterrorism, Elizabeth Neumann, says that most of Iran’s proxies are “pretty much decimated or severely hampered.”

title: Rep. Himes: Effectiveness of U.S. strikes on Iran is ‘too early to tell’
description: ABC News’ Jonathan Karl interviews Rep. Jim Himes, D- Conn., on “This Week.”

title: Iran launches attack on US base in Qatar
description: Iran has attacked a U.S. base in Qatar, according to Iranian State TV.

title: Trump announces successful attack on Iran nuclear sites
description: President Donald Trump announced on social media Saturday night that the U.S. attacked three nuclear sites in Iran, "including Fordow, Natanz, and Esfahan."

title: Diddy Trial Day 27: Jurors hear logistics of alleged ‘freak offs’
description: Prosecutors are almost ready to wrap their case against Sean Combs. On Monday, June 23, jurors saw files such as text messages and hotel receipts. ABC News’ Eva Pilgrim and contributors explain.

title: 2 shark attacks reported at Hilton Head Island in 1 week: Officials
description: A second shark bite has been reported at Hilton Head Island, South Carolina, within one week, local officials said.

title: As heat wave grips half the nation, nighttime temperatures will bring little relief
description: A dangerous heat wave has set in over roughly half of the nation, leaving nearly 150 million people from Texas to Maine under heat alerts on Monday.

title: Trump announces Iran-Israel ceasefire after Iran's retaliatory strikes
description: A ceasefire deal has been reached between Israel and Iran, Pres. Trump announced. It comes on the heels of Iran's retaliatory strikes on the Al Udeid Air Base – the largest U.S. base in the region.

title: Trump announces ceasefire between Israel and Iran
description: President Donald Trump announced on social media that Israel and Iran have agreed to a complete and total ceasefire, set to begin in approximately 6 hours.

title: Trump calls Iran's attack "very weak," says "it's time for peace"
description: As Iran launched a retaliatory strike on a U.S. base in Qatar, Pres. Trump huddled with his national security team in the Oval Office, while Pentagon leaders tracked the missiles.

title: Iran's Supreme Leader goes underground as IDF launches wave of attacks in Tehran
description: Iran's Supreme Leader Ayatollah Khamenei has not been seen in public for nearly two weeks.

title: ABC News Live Prime: June 23, 2025
description: Iran strikes U.S. air base in Qatar; pro-Palestinian activist Mahmoud Khalil speaks out; Sen. Lisa Murkowski reacts to Iran strikes; 150 million Americans face life-threatening heat.

title: Mahmoud Khalil speaks out after release from ICE detention
description: Mahmoud Khalil, the Columbia University pro-Palestinian activist who was detained by ICE for over three months, spoke with ABC News’ Linsey Davis in his first on-camera interview since his release.

title: Iran launches retaliatory strike against US base in Qatar
description: The U.S. says there have been no casualties and there are no plans to retaliate after Iran fired at Al Udeid Air Base in Qatar. The White House is calling for peace in the wake of the weekend strikes.

title: Trump to attend NATO summit days after US strikes on Iran and with a ceasefire in hand
description: Trump departing for NATO summit in The Netherlands days after he launched strikes against Iran and hours after he announced a Israel-Iran cease-fire.
